data.title: Hotfix Patch Notes — July 15, 2025
data.content:
Attention, Pilots! The following hotfix will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on July 15, 2025.

New Content

New War Robot and Weapon

A new unannounced War Robot and Weapon have been added to the game as part of the Store and Daily Deals. 

More details regarding this War Robot will be revealed in a separate publication on July 15, 2025!

New Titan Weapon (Bayonet)

Event Duration: July 15 - July 22

  • Alpha now supports a second weapon: Bayonet
  • Bayonet is now available in Slot 5 and 6 of Daily Deals with a higher drop change during the event.

Intel Discount Event

Event Duration: July 15 - July 29

Reduced the intel upgrade cost based on rarities for specified War Robots and Titans (including Modules, Gear and Weapons) for the duration of this event.

  • War Robots: Lancelot, Ares, Varangian, Ravana, Typhon
  • Titans: Alpha

Note: As the Alpha Weapon “Bayonet” is newly added to the game, it will not be included as part of this event.

More details on reductions will be shared in a separate publication on July 15, 2025.

Daily Deal Bonus Feature

We have added a loyalty feature to the Daily Deals section. When purchasing Salvage from Daily Deals, players can now receive additional rewards for hitting Milestones on total amounts of purchased Salvage. These rewards include Intel and customization options, including a new customization type: Animated Wraps.

More details on exact rewards and milestones will be shared in a separate publication on July 15, 2025.

Daily Deal Freeze Feature

We have added the option to freeze Daily Deals. This option lets you select an item in Daily Deals and prevent it from rotating out, allowing you to save an item you’re interested in until you’re ready to buy it.

  • You can only freeze one item at a time.
  • If you decide you do not want the item you have frozen, you can remove your freeze and add it to another item that you desire.
  • The freeze will be lifted on the reset timer of Daily Deals and if you refresh your Daily Deals manually. If you refresh your Daily Deals manually, remember to reapply your Freeze before refreshing again.

With the introduction of the Freeze Feature and Bonus Feature for Daily Deals, the “Buy All” button price (WarpReals) has been increased. The price will also increase dynamically after the second purchase. The dynamic pricing resets to the starting value each day.

Animated Wraps

A new type of customization has been added to the game: Animated Wraps. In this update, two Animated Wraps have been added to the game:

  • Hyperpop - Available through Daily Deal Bonus Reward milestones.
  • Pyroclast - Available through WarpReal bundles in the Store.

You can equip your Animated Wrap similar to Factory Wraps. Select the War Robot you would like to Paint and then equip your newly found Animated Wrap from the Wraps interface.

Gameplay Adjustments

  • The minimap now shows the exact location of Power Ups, even if they are still on cooldown.

Balancing Adjustments

Shoulder Modules

We have adjusted the upgrade values for Shoulders based on War Robot Class.

  • Assault: 
    • Shield Cooldown Reduction (+4% compared to previous values at level 13)
    • Additional Armor (+6% compared to previous values at level 13)
  • Tactician:
    • Shield Cooldown Reduction (+2% compared to previous values at level 13)
    • Shield Regeneration Rate (+15% compared to previous values at level 13)
  • Defender:
    • Shield Cooldown Reduction (+2% compared to previous values at level 13)
    • Additional Armor (+12% compared to previous values at level 13)
  • Flanker:
    • Additional Shiled Amount (+8% compared to previous values at level 13)
